name: purchase-request
title: DRAFT purchase request
for_each: select id,sku||' at '||location as name from v_plan where buy_units>0

sections.title: Open supply to confirm
sections.sql: select reference,units,received,due,evidence from orders where position_id=$1 and status='open'

name: stock-review
title: Stock review record
for_each: select id,sku||' at '||location name from positions where active

sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: select note,actor,due,resolved from reviews where position_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,finding from v_compliance where id=$1
